AAREYDRUGS.technical: Price trades above its 21-EMA, 50-SMA, and 200-SMA, attempting a double-bottom neckline breakout near 107.96 with RSI at 68. The rounded base measures 26.6% deep with a 6.5% handle, but recent price advances lack decisive institutional volume accumulation.
AAREYDRUGS.fundamental: AAREYDRUGS violates CANSLIM earnings criteria. Q1 revenue dropped 55% YoY alongside a 25% contraction in EPS. Operating margins remain thin at 2-3%, leaving bottom-line profitability fragile despite a modest balance sheet debt load.
AAREYDRUGS.risk: Breakdown below the 99.56 stop or 50-day SMA violates base integrity; Minervini discipline requires an immediate loss cut.

ABSLLIQUID.technical: Trading tightly above short and long moving averages near 1006 on 4.53x volume, but price action represents overnight interest accrual rather than genuine equity demand accumulation.
ABSLLIQUID.risk: Instrument is a liquid debt ETF without equity capital appreciation potential; the 1003.83 stop applies mechanically.

ACE.technical: Strong Stage 2 structure aligned above rising 21-EMA, 50-SMA, and 200-SMA. Double-bottom pivot at 1269.27 displays good price recovery and RSI at 71 confirms momentum, though approaching overhead resistance requires disciplined entry.
ACE.fundamental: Sound capital goods fundamental profile with net margins around 15%, ROCE near 38%, and a debt-free balance sheet. While Q1 sales rose 20%, EPS growth (+22%) fell just shy of CANSLIM's 25% benchmark.
ACE.risk: Failure to hold 1269.27 or a breach of the 1184.07 stop invalidates the pivot structure; exit promptly.

ADFFOODS.technical: Price holds constructive Stage 2 alignment above its 21-EMA, 50-SMA, and 200-SMA, consolidating tightly within 1.5% of the 331.08 pivot on 1.38x volume. RSI at 61 indicates calm base accumulation.
ADFFOODS.fundamental: ADF Foods demonstrates consistent execution with 18-20% operating margins, strong ROCE (~22%), and a debt-free balance sheet. Top-line growth of 26% is robust, but EPS expansion (+13%) misses the 25% CANSLIM standard.
ADFFOODS.risk: Rejection at the 331.08 ceiling or closing below the 309.43 stop negates the consolidation pivot; cut risk fast.

AEROFLEX.technical: Premier Stage 2 momentum candidate. Price respects rising 21-EMA, 50-SMA, and 200-SMA, completing a double-bottom base with a neckline trigger at 584.73 on 1.8x volume expansion, confirming genuine institutional accumulation.
AEROFLEX.fundamental: Outstanding CANSLIM characteristics with explosive quarterly EPS acceleration (+158% YoY) backed by 72% revenue growth. Maintains healthy operating margins (>20%), high return metrics (ROCE > 20%), and negligible debt service obligations.
AEROFLEX.risk: Thesis fails if price slips back below the 525.74 stop or breaks the 21-day EMA; execute loss cuts without hesitation.

AONELIQUID.technical: Clearing a 30-session high near 1080.67 above basic trend lines, but movement reflects cash-equivalent yields and rate mechanics rather than equity demand or CANSLIM accumulation.
AONELIQUID.risk: Cash-management ETF unsuited for swing growth; the 1080.22 stop level serves only as a technical boundary.
